1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part XVIII) covers the method of measurement of demolition and dismantling in buildings and civil engineering works. NOTE - For the purpose of this standard the term ` dismantling ' implies care_

fully taking up or down and removing without damage. The articles rhPll be passed by hand, whrre necessary, and lowered to the ground, and not thrown, and where these are fixed by nails, screws, bolts, etc, theseshall be taken out with proper tools and not by tearing or ripping off and the term ` demolition ' implies trrking up or down, or-breaking up.
